production_model: Cut and sewn in Los Angeles
notes: About: 'handcrafted quality denim goods and apparel'; 'Proudly cut and sewn in Los Angeles, CA'; began in 2008 as a custom denim workshop in American Rag's World Denim Bar; first ready-to-wear capsule Fall 2009 with the Dean (later the best-selling Stanton fit), SK and Standard Issue; same family-owned LA factories since the start (https://rogueterritory.com/pages/about).

Domestic shipping by pre-tax total: under $30 $5, under $100 $7, under $400 $12, over $400 free; international flat $45 transit only, duties paid by customer (https://rogueterritory.com/pages/payment-shipping).
Returns within 30 days for refund less shipping; unworn, unwashed, unhemmed; marked-down items final sale (https://rogueterritory.com/policies/refund-policy).
Jeans waist sizes (products.json): 27–36, 38, 40 (40 on 7 styles, 27 on 7).
